name: What questions should a property owner ask before hiring a project manager?

mainEntity.name: What should owners ask before hiring a commercial project management firm?
mainEntity.text: What should owners ask before hiring a commercial project management firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a commercial project manager, owners should ask targeted questions about comparable projects, permitting experience, schedule control, communication style, and cost management. It helps to ask how the firm handles occupied buildings, long-lead items, change orders, and owner approvals. Owners should also request sample reports and references from similar jobs rather than relying only on marketing language. In Los Angeles, it is also smart to ask about familiarity with local agencies and jurisdiction-specific workflows. A good project manager should be able to explain how they prevent surprises, how often they communicate, and what they need from the owner to keep the project moving. If the answers are vague, that is usually a warning sign.
acceptedAnswer.description: Owners should ask about similar project experience, local permit knowledge, reporting cadence, fee structure, subcontractor coordination, and how the firm handles delays and change orders. The answers reveal whether the firm is organized, transparent, and capable of managing the project’s real risks.
